destination.name: Corfu
destination.summary: Corfu can be an old-town stay, a coastal holiday or a mix of the two, depending on your base. The island's villages and beaches are not all a short walk apart, so choose the atmosphere you want first. Keep room for everyday coastal time rather than driving to a new stop each morning.
destination.bestFor: Old-town exploring, coastal bases and slower island days
destination.pace: One comfortable base, with selective outings
destination.gettingAround: Check local transport for your chosen base and any evening return journey. Car hire may help with dispersed places, but roads and parking still take time. Compare beach access, nearby dining and the specific arrival transfer before choosing accommodation.
destination.timing: The climate averages describe a representative island location. Use them for broad trip planning, then check seasonal facilities and transport. A cultural old-town visit and a beach-focused stay have different requirements, particularly outside busy periods.
